# Integrate Medical Scribe

The calls themselves: where they live, what they need in their headers, every operation, and one request written out in full.

## Hosts

- `https://api.eka.care` Production server
- `https://api.dev.eka.care` Development server

## Auth and headers

Get a token first: [Authentication](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/auth/getting-started).

- `auth`: HTTP bearer. Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

| Method | Path | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | [`/voice/v1/.well-known/medscribealliance`](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/scribe/protocol/discovery) | Discovery |

| `GET` | [`/voice/v1/sessions/{session_id}`](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/scribe/sessions/get-session) | Get Session |

## One request in full

POST /voice/v1/sessions, from [its page](https://developer.eka.care/api-sdk/scribe/sessions/create-session).

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.eka.care/voice/v1/sessions' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
  "language_hint": [
    "en"
  ],
  "model": "pro",
  "templates": [
    "clinical_notes_template"
  ],
  "upload_type": "single",
  "additional_data": {
    "source": "mobile_app",
    "app_version": "1.0.0"
  },
  "patient_details": {
    "oid": "PAT-12345",
    "name": "John Doe"
  }
}'
```
